Generated by `drizzle-kit generate` 1.0.0-rc.4 (the version `@guren/orm` pins), one
schema edit per step, unedited. `migration-guard.test.ts` reads them as real input.

- step1: create `users` (with `bio`, `age` integer, `email` varchar(255)) and `posts`
- step2: remove `posts`
- step3: remove `users.bio`
- step4: narrow `age` to smallint and `email` to varchar(50) (SQLite: `age` to text and `email` NOT NULL, a table rebuild)
- step5: add `users.nick` (PostgreSQL: and an index)
- step6 (PostgreSQL only): widen `age` back to integer and `email` to varchar(500)

`sqlite-rebuild/` is a second SQLite run: create `users` and `posts`, then give
`posts.title` a default, then give `posts.user_id` a foreign key. drizzle-kit
writes a `__new_posts` rebuild for each of the last two, copying every column.
